instruction: Inspect both images. For every opaque token, return two independent labels. coarse_roles describes visible/source layout: STREAM for every ordinary readable heading or body block, including advertisements and notices; MASTHEAD only for page-title/date/page-number fragments; OTHER for ornaments/non-reading elements; UNKNOWN if genuinely unreadable. Do not distinguish HEADER from TEXT: frozen software does that from geometry. editorial_genres describes function: ARTICLE, ADVERT, NOTICE, MASTHEAD, OTHER, or UNKNOWN. Genre never controls STREAM membership. Do not return eligibility, order, groups, articles, transcription, or fine physical roles. Mark uncertainty separately for each axis. Tokens are random. Return JSON only.

selected_on: A08 consumed page 0044 defined the narrow-bridge failure class but contributed no validation score to parameter selection

axis_policy.coarse_role: STREAM means every ordinary readable heading or body block
axis_policy.fine_role: STREAM is HEADER iff block_height / page_height <= 0.020, otherwise TEXT
axis_policy.editorial_genre: independent proposal that cannot remove content
axis_policy.semantic_units: frozen header-boundary rule after role refinement

frozen_profile.reference_warning: Source roles/order/SSU remain provisional; genre is unadjudicated; this page cannot validate word geometry.

leakage_control: Random tokens reveal no source ID, order, physical role, genre or semantic unit. XML, binding and reference are outside the reader packet.
binding_control: Strict software validation binds both complete maps; no repair is permitted.
reference_warning: Physical role/order/SSU are provisional corpus labels. Editorial genre has no adjudicated reference and is not scored. Page 0050 is consumed after scoring.
